name: cortico-world-x
description: Cortico World: X 时间线 —— 借本机浏览器只读 X 的公开内容，读到的每条落进本地知识库，摘要进对话，必要时导出成记忆包。不登录新账号、不点赞转发关注私信。零第三方依赖。

zh.description: 她能看 X：主时间线、某人的帖子、搜索、列表、话题。读到的东西落进本地知识库（Markdown + JSONL，人读可审计），按配置投摘要进对话，需要时导出成记忆包。用本机 Chromium 的调试口只读，不新建账号、不点赞转发关注私信。

en.description: She reads X: the home timeline, one person's posts, search, lists and hashtags. What she reads lands in a local knowledge base (Markdown + JSONL, auditable by a human), digests go into the conversation, and the base exports as a memory bundle. Read-only through the local Chromium debugging port: no new account, no likes, reposts, follows or DMs.
